parameters.name: clientId
parameters.description: This field the Client ID that was provided by PayU while onboarding.

account_number.description: This parameter must contain the account number to be verified.

ifsc.description: This parameter must contain the bank IFSC code.

name.description: This parameter must contain the account holder name.

name_match_required.description: This parameter must be set to true if the name must match along with bank account verification.

leniency.description: If name_match_required is set to true, this parameter must contain any of the following: -Medium   -High   -Low
